# Eno Bassé Diamonds

> Eno Bassé Diamonds is a fine jewelry house based in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria, offering handcrafted diamond rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and bangles, along with bespoke custom design and jewelry care services.

Eno Bassé sources ethically-obtained diamonds and precious metals, and works with artisan jewelers to create both ready-to-buy collections and fully custom, made-to-order pieces (including engagement rings). Prices are available on request for most pieces given the bespoke nature of fine jewelry.

## Shop

- [All Products](https://enobasse.com/products): Full catalog of rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and bangles.
- [Collections](https://enobasse.com/collections): Curated jewelry collections grouped by style and category.

## Services

- [Custom Jewelry Design](https://enobasse.com/custom-design): Bespoke, made-to-order jewelry design consultations.
- [Ring Resizing](https://enobasse.com/ring-resizing): Professional ring resizing service.
- [Jewelry Maintenance & Repairs](https://enobasse.com/maintenance-repairs): Cleaning, polishing, and repair of fine jewelry.
- [Size Guide](https://enobasse.com/size-guide): Ring and jewelry sizing reference.
- [Creative Studio](https://enobasse.com/creative-studio): Interactive 3D ring configurator for designing a custom engagement ring.
